phase: Counter snapshots before and after the page-tier configuration change
limitations: Counters are cumulative operations, not distinct histories or saved prefill seconds.
The after-restart snapshot includes maintenance test traffic and ordinary production traffic.
Different lifetimes and cache state prevent an isolated before/after performance comparison.
The snapshot establishes page/state reuse counts, not the performance benefit of enabling or disabling either tier.

definitions.ram_share_page_allocations: RAM page restores / total GPU page allocations; operations can revisit the same prefix.
definitions.recurrent_restores: Matching hybrid-state checkpoint restores; KV can remain GPU resident.
definitions.ram_kv_budget_mib: Pinned KV-page-cache byte budget; complete pages include main and draft KV.
definitions.ram_kv_token_slot_ceiling: Page-slot ceiling, not distinct retained history or expanded per-request context.
